title: #Manager.1.0.0.Manager

MACAddress.description: This is the currently configured MAC address of the (logical port) interface.
MACAddress.longDescription: The value of this property shall be the effective current MAC Address of this interface. If an assignable MAC address is not supported, this is a read only alias of the PermanentMACAddress.

IPv4Addresses.description: The IPv4 addresses assigned to this interface
IPv4Addresses.longDescription: The value of this property shall be an array of objects used to represent the IPv4 connection characteristics for this interface.

ManagerForPDUs.description: This property is an array of references to the PDUs that this manager has control over.
ManagerForPDUs.longDescription: This is a reference to a collection of PDU resources.

ManagerForSwitches.description: This property is an array of references to the switches that this manager has control over.
ManagerForSwitches.longDescription: This is a reference to a collection of switch resources.

Interface.description: This is a the IPv4 information the the BMC
Interface.longDescription: The represents the IPv4 information for the BMC.

Chassis.description: A reference to the chassis that contains this manager
Chassis.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a reference to the resource that represents this chassis and shall be of type Chassis.

ComputeSystem.description: A reference to the system that contains this manager
ComputeSystem.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a reference to the resource that represents this ComputerSystem and shall be of type System.

LogServices.description: This is a reference to a collection of Logs used by the manager.
LogServices.longDescription: The value of this property shall contain a reference to a collection of type LogServiceCollection which are for the use of this manager.

Manager.description: This is the schema definition for a Manager.  Examples of managers are BMCs, Enclosure Managers, Management Controllers and other subsystems assigned managability functions.
Manager.longDescription: This resource shall be used to represent a management subsystem for a Redfish implementation.
